summary.content:
Today's selection covers 49 articles from 7 trusted sources, including 31 on Artificial Intelligence and 7 on Fraud/Cybersecurity.

• **AI Spotlight**: Phishing poses as big-brand job interview to steal Google accounts
• **Companies in Focus**: Coverage includes developments from OpenAI, Google, Anthropic
• **Security Alert**: The ‘first’ AI-run ransomware attack still needed a human
• **Threat Landscape**: Today's coverage highlights ransomware, malware
• **Source Diversity**: Articles sourced from TechCrunch, BleepingComputer, Dark Reading, NY Times Tech, The Verge and others
• **Fresh Content**: 37 articles published in the last 24 hours

top.title: You can now customize Siri’s pace and expressivity in the latest iOS 27 beta
top.description: The update is part of Apple's broader effort to make Siri feel more natural and personal, as it rebuilds the assistant around generative AI.

top.title: Reddit is using LLMs to solve a problem LLMs largely created
top.description: In the AI era, platforms have no choice but to fight fire with fire to cull spam.

top.title: JadePuffer: The First Complete LLM-Driven Ransomware Attack
top.description: An "agentic threat actor" successfully exploited a Langflow flaw to steal data from a production database server and encrypt other systems.

top.title: To Reduce Electrical Grid Strain Amid Heat Wave, Data Centers Are Ordered to Use Backup Power
top.description: As triple-digit temperatures engulf much of the United States, the Trump administration wants grid managers to require the use of backup power that often goes unused.
